name: Thimble Moonwhisker
description: Single-needle plants drawn the way a very small botanist would, one patient hairline at a time.

designs.title: Fern Frond
designs.description: A curling frond with every leaflet ruled in by hand. Delicate enough for a wrist or a collarbone.

designs.title: Poppy and Seed Head
designs.description: An open poppy beside its seed head, all thin line and no fill. Sits well along the forearm.

designs.title: Foxglove Spire
designs.description: A tall spire of freckled bells, narrow and vertical, made for the ribs or the back of a calf.

designs.title: Moon Thistle
designs.description: A prickly thistle in bloom against a thin crescent moon. Soft line, sharp plant.

designs.title: Forest Caps
designs.description: Three spotted toadstools on a tuft of grass. A small woodland scene for the ankle.

designs.title: Wild Sprig Wreath
designs.description: A round wreath of leaves and tiny blossoms around one quiet flower.
